name: Myntra M-Now
access: Myntra programme enrollment and the account-specific MMIP/OMS integration contract. PPMP access alone does not establish M-Now coverage.
identity: Myntra order and line IDs, seller SKU, and an explicit M-Now identifier in the approved feed or programme-only report.
stock: Confirm the fulfillment facility and whether stock is shared, dedicated, or held in partner custody. Confirm the programme quantity formula before any publication.

name: Amazon Now
access: Amazon Now seller enrollment and confirmation of the supported order, inventory and reconciliation interface. Normal SP-API authorization does not prove Now coverage.
identity: Amazon order ID, seller SKU and a provider-confirmed Now programme identifier; do not infer Now from delivery speed or postcode.
stock: Identify the micro/urban fulfillment centre and stock ownership. Do not publish merchant warehouse quantities into fulfillment-centre custody or assume FBA totals are Now stock.

name: Amazon Fresh
access: Fresh enrollment and the merchant-specific integration contract, including the applicable fulfillment model.
identity: Amazon order ID and seller SKU with a confirmed Fresh programme field or programme-only report.
stock: Confirm the physical facility, custody, units and expiry-sensitive availability. Fresh must not reuse a Now or MFN stock pool by assumption.

name: Flipkart Minutes
access: Minutes onboarding and partner-confirmed access to its seller order and facility inventory data. Standard Flipkart listing access is not evidence of Minutes access.
identity: Canonical Flipkart order ID, seller SKU and the Minutes identifier from the approved feed or programme-only report.
stock: Map the micro-fulfillment centre and declared custody. Do not combine its quantities with warehouse sellable stock.

name: Shopsy
access: Shopsy seller enrollment and confirmation of which Seller Hub account, listing interface and order discriminator cover Shopsy.
identity: Use the existing Flipkart order identity if the provider confirms it is shared; verify the Shopsy order discriminator before classification.
stock: Confirm whether the listing shares Flipkart inventory or has a dedicated allocation. Never count a shared offer quantity twice.

name: bigbasket bbnow
access: bigbasket supplier enrollment and an approved bbnow inventory/order report or machine-feed contract. A consumer app is not a seller API.
identity: Contracted supplier item, order and facility identifiers; confirm whether the feed contains consumer orders or supplier purchase orders.
stock: Separate supplied/partner-held stock from your physical warehouse balance. A supplier purchase order must not be treated as a consumer sale.
